validity.researcher_notes: The sheet owner Globaltec LLC is in liquidation. A liquidator was named on 6 March 2025 and the company is to cease by 20 February 2026. Control moved from A-Property to Andrey Ni in March 2024. The pipeline has no builder or financing in sight. A person should decide whether the owner changes or the row is shelved or cancelled.
The sheet cost of 5 billion euros is the cost of the whole Yakutia LNG project, plant and pipelines together. No source gives the pipeline alone.

fills.researcher_notes: LNG Prime, citing the developer A-Property, says the Yakutia LNG project involves building a 1358 kilometers long pipeline from Yatek's fields to the plant near Ayan. Matches the sheet's 1358 km. The two LNG Prime articles trace to the same company statement, so they are not independent. Other citations give rounder figures: the YATEC 2022 annual report says more than 1,300 km and Interfax says about 1.4 thousand km. A 2023 Neftegaz.ru article, found on the wiki citation list, also states 1358 km for the Kysyl-Syr to Amga and Amga to Ayan pipeline. It was read through a Wayback copy.

LNG Prime (January 2022 article) says A-Property planned a final investment decision at the end of 2023 and a launch in 2027. That is the project launch year, which the sheet uses as the pipeline start year. A Yakutia media report says the developer planned to build the trunk pipeline by the end of 2027, but that page returned 403 to the verifier, so it is not cited. The date is old and the project has since stalled; no start month is given.

No wiki citation states a cost for the pipeline alone. LNG Prime says the whole Yakutia LNG project could be worth about 5 billion euros. That is a system figure for the plant plus pipelines, and a system figure is not a ref for this row. The sheet's 5000000000 EUR is the project total. See the validity record.

fills.researcher_notes: The sheet says shelved. The wiki says proposed, an older view. Kartoteka.news of 10 March 2025 reports that Globaltek, the project's special purpose company, was given a liquidator on 6 March 2025 and must cease to exist by 20 February 2026. It does not say the project is shelved in words, but it fits. Existing refs on the sheet are kept.

The Globaltek company project page (Wayback copy of 17 June 2023) gives the pipeline throughput as 28 plus billion cubic meters a year and a length over 1300 km. That states the sheet's 28 bcm/y, as a company figure. The Government decree 816-r of 2015 gives 20 bcm a year for the Yakutia gas project main gas pipeline. The two disagree, see the validity record. The Wayback page loaded when read by hand but the automatic check failed with a connection error on three tries.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The sheet already says shelved. The latest dated report is from March 2025 and says the project company is in liquidation. That supports shelved or later cancelled. The wiki says proposed, which is older. No change proposed.
